tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 339)zab chos mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las:mkha' 'gro'i srog sgrub yang bcud snying po bzhugs so:āḥchos rnams rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang nyid las:rang lus da
339)zab chos mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las:mkha' 'gro'i srog sgrub yang bcud snying po bzhugs so:āḥchos rnams rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang nyid las:rang lus da

tei:div.tei:p: 339)zab chos mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: mkha' 'gro'i srog sgrub yang bcud snying po bzhugs so: āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang nyid las: rang lus dag pa 'od kyi gong bu ru: tsit+ta rang byung rnam dag gzhal yas khang: dwangs ma lnga ldan 'od lnga'i klong dkyil du: mi shigs thig le bde chen 'dus ma byas: ka dag rang byung mi 'gyur chos kyi sku: lhun grub gdangs gsal phag mo dmar mo mdzes: ye shes rtsa bzhir sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i 'khor: gdan gsum zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa: gdod nas dam ye dbyer med chen por rdzogs: rang gsal rtsol bral sngags kyi 'phro 'du nyid: snang srid mnyam nyid dag pa rab 'byams ngang: ma ha ri ni sa:

de ltar chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du: yid bzlas bya zhing rig gdangs skyongs: 'od gsal zung 'jug thob par nges: sa ma ya: brda thim: gsang rgya: sbas rgya: ḍak+ki'i rgya: ces pa 'di yang bde ba'i rdo rjes so// ༈ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi cha lag rgyun khyer tshogs mchod bsdus pa ni: 340)āḥ snang ba snod kyi gtor gzhong du: srid pa'i dpal yon tshogs su bshams: 'bru gsum nus pas bdud rtsir brlabs: zag med mchod pa'i sprin du gyur: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang: yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam can srung mar bcas pa la: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: zhen med rang grol klong du bzhes: thugs dam bskang la nyams chags bshags: gzung 'dzin bdag med chen por bsgral: ye shes lha yi zhal du bstab: bde ba chen po'i dngos grub stsol: lhag skyong mgron rnams lhag la rol: don gnyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba'i mthus: bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa: mi gnas gtan srid zin par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: : zhes pa'ang pad+ma grub dbang rdo rjes yang yang nan cher bskul ngor su kha badz+ra rtsal gyis shar mar bris pa'o// dge'o/ 341)thugs tig mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud las: nyams len gnad kyi man ngag ḍā ki'i thugs bcud bzhugs so: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud: bdag nyid chen mo mkhar chen mtsho rgyal ma: rang don mthar phyin gzhan don rlabs chen mdzad: ma hā gu rus thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs: gsang sngags chos kyi bka' yi gnyer byang 'dzin: sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas: khyad par zab mo gter gyi bstan pa ni: ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas ngan ma stongs par: de srid 'gro 'dul gter ston rgyun mi 'chad: bod khams lha mi zab mo gter gyis 'dren: las can rjes 'jug zab mo'i lam 'jug phyir:

nyams len gnad kyi man ngag 'di ru bstan: sa ma ya: dang po lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma bsten: chos min 'khor ba'i gnas ngan rgyang spangs nas: yang dag lam 'jug blo ldog rnam pa bzhis: rgyud sbyangs 'khor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin la: bsam nas yang yang rang blo chos la bsgyur: sems can pha ma'i rang bzhin nges mthong nas: kun la gnod sems spangs nas byang chub sems: smon dang 'jug pa'i sgo nas rgya cher bskyed: tshad med snying rjes rang rgyud legs 343)sbyangs nas: dang po yul gyi zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir: mi yi rgyu 'grul med pa'i dben gnas su: dgra jag la sogs 'tsho ba med pa'i sar: gcig pur gnas bca' bde ba'i mal du ni: ku sa li yi drang srong 'dug stangs kyis: mig gnyis thad kyi nam mkhar blta bzhin du: ma dag yul snang thams cad stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las me long gzugs brnyan bzhin: rang bzhin rnam dag zhing khams yid 'ong ba: rin chen sa gzhi sman gyi spang ri la: bdud rtsi'i chu mig shing sna 'bru yi rigasaḥ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang 'ja' gur 'khrigs: mig mangs ris dang drwa ba drwa phyed tshul: blta bas mi ngoms gsal 'tsher lhun stug par: gsal zhing rang lus hūm̐ dkar zhig tu bsgom: hūm̐ las 'od dkar zla 'od bzhin du 'phros: phyi nang ma dag snod bcud kun la khyab: yul 'dzin 'khrul pa'i snang ba dbyings su nub: dag pa rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing du brlabs: de ltar dmigs pa'i gnad dang ma bral bar: yang yang sbyangs pas yul zhen rang grol nas: rang bzhin 344)dag pa'i zhing khams mngon du 'gyur: sa ma ya: gnyis pa lus kyi stong ra sbyong pa ni: hūm̐ yig gnas gyur 'od thig rnam par gyur: thig le bam̐ yig dmar po es mtshan pa: de las 'od 'phros rgyal kun mchod pas mnyes: dbang byin nus pa 'od dmar rnam par bsdus: bam̐ yig la thim gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: 'od zer mar 'phros 'gro drug las nyon sbyangs:

snod bcud dwangs ma'i snying po tshur 'dus thim: yongs gyur rang nyid 'od lus dwangs ma'i sku: ḍā ki'i gtso mchog mkha' spyod rnal 'byor ma: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa: phyag g.yas gri gug phyag g.yon bhan+dha 'dzin: dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam rtse bran mdzes: mchan g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni dar snas brgyan: zhabs gnyis gar stabs pad nyi bam gdan 'gying: sku la dar dang rin chen rus pas spras: zhi ma khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams ldan pa: ye shes 'ja' sku stong gsal chen por bsgom: de ltar sgyu ma lus kyi stong ra ni: dmigs gnad ldan pas yang yang nyams blangs na: ma dag sgyu lus dag pa sku ru smin: sa ma ya: 345)gsum pa rtsa yi stong ra sbyong ba ni: rang nyid mkha' spyod dbang mo'i sku dbus su: rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i rim pa 'di ltar bsgom: dbus su dbu ma drang srab snum gsal ba: phyi dkar nang dmar bar sngo mda' smyug tsam: yar sna spyi bor ha rer zug pa dang: mar sna gsang bar tshigs kyis 'gag ltar gnas: de yis g.yas su ro ma mda' smyug tsam: phyi dkar nang dmar drang srab snum gsal 'bar: g.yon du rkyang ma phyi dmar nang dkar ba: gsal 'tsher 'od 'bar mda' smyug 'bring po tsam: rtsa gsum sba phran gshibs ltar lus dbus su: kwa ba btsugs bzhin 'greng nger gnas pa la: spyi bo chu yi 'khor lor rnam pa ni: rtsa 'dab dkar gsal sbrul chun gshibs pa ltar: drug cu rtsa bzhi dwangs gsal tshul du bsgom: mgrin pa me yi yi 'khor lor rnam pa ni: dmar gsal rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis ni: gdugs rtsibs bzhin gyis 'brel mar gnas par bsgom: snying gar nam mkha'i 'khor lo rnam pa ni: mthing gsal 'od 'bar rtsa 'dab nyi zer ltar: gnas pa brgyad ni dwangs gsal 'od du bsgom: lte bar sa yi 'khor lo rnam pa ni: 446)ser gsal rtsa 'dab bcu drug 'khor lo ltar: gnas pa 'od kyi rtsa ru bsgom par bya:

gsang gnas rlung gi 'khor lo rnam pa ni: rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad ljang 'od gsal: ljon shing ltar gyes gong ma'i mar sna 'brel: de ltar rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga bsgoms pas: ma dag las rlung dag pa bcud du smin: thabs mchog zab mo'i myur lam 'di ka'o: sa ma ya: de ltar phyi nang stong ra sbyangs pa'i mthar: snang rtog lha yi phyag rgya dang ldan ngang: dwangs snyigs 'byed thabs rlung gi man ngag ni: rnam par mdzad kyi chos bdun 'dug stangs bcas: dang po ma dag rlung dug sbyong ba la: dug gsum rgyus bskyed las rlung kha dog ni: khams nag dmar nag sngo nag dud khu'i mdog: gsum po ro rkyang lam brgyud sna sgor thon: phyir phud rten med nam mkha'i dbyings dang bsres: tshe rabs nas bsags las sgrib bag chags rnams: gcig las dug gsum rlung dang dbyer med du: phyi rol nam mkha'i dbyings su thim par bsam: dbugs thengs gcig la ha sgra bcas thon pa: gsum byas ma dag las rlung kun dag nas: dwangs ma'i rtsa sbubs rkyen dang bral bar 347)bsam: yang yang sbyangs pas las rlung 'phel zad nas: dag pa ye rlung las su 'chun par 'gyur: de nas mdun mkhar glan sor bcu'i mtshams su: 'od dkar klong du āḥdakar dri ma med: gsal 'tsher 'od 'bar gcig bsgom yun gcig gnas: a yig yongs gyur mdun mkhar pad zla'i steng: skyabs kun yongs 'dus drin chen bla ma dang: dbyer med mtsho skyes rdo rje he ru ka: dkar dmar mdangs ldan gcer mo rgyan drug gsol: zhal gcig phyag gnyis cang te'u bhan thod 'dzin: dbu skra thor cog zar bu sku rgyab bkram: stag shams smad dkris dar ljang dpyangs pas mdzes: spyan gnyis 'bru tshugs nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs: thugs kyi dgongs pa skal ldan bu la gtad: ye shes 'ja' 'od lnga ldan 'khyil klong du: chu zla 'ja' tshon lta bur lam mer bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i bla ma'i gnas gsum las:

byin rlabs ye shes 'dus pa'i rlung bcud ni: spos reng dud pa bzhin byung rang nyid kyi: sna bug nas zhugs ro rkyang lam brgyud nas: lus nang thams cad ye shes rlung mchog gis: sngo ltem gyis gang bsam zhing dar gcig tu: nang rlung 348)ci nus thub tsam bar du bzung: ma dag rtsa rlung thig le'i dri ma rnams: lus kyi ba spu gshang lam rkang mthil nas: thon te 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor du: thim par bsam zhing dwangs ma lte 'og bcag: nang rlung phyir phud tshe na dal bus brtson: de ltar sbyangs pas las su ma 'chun bar: dmigs gnad dang bcas yang yang bsgom par bya: slar yang 'byin 'jug bskyil ba gnad gsum la: brten nas dbang byin thugs rgyud bskul ba ni: bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang: dbang byin nus pa thams cad oṃ la bsdu: oṃ yig ye shes rlung gi rnam pa ru: rang gi sna bug nas brgyud ro rkyang nas: dbu ma'i lam zhugs āḥyi rnam par bskyil: rtsa gnas thams cad ye ge'i 'khor lo ru: smin par bsam zhing rlung bcud lte 'og bcag: lhag ma hūṃ gi rnam par phyir bsal nas: bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang sgo gsum: tha dad med par ro gcig 'dres par bsam: rlung sems dbyer med spros bral ngang nyid du: ngal bso snod bcud dag mnyam klong du bsgom: de yis sgo gsum tha mal mngon zhen ldog: snang srid dag pa sku gsum 'khor lor rdzogs: thim sdud 'od gsal rtogs pa ngang gis 349)'char: rtsol bral ye shes rlung la rang dbang 'byor: rtsa thig rlung gi skyon rnams kun bral nas: lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur thabs zab mo: las rlung kun rtog dbyings su zhi bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: de nas gtum mo rlung lnga bsgom pa ni: dbu ma'i yar sne spyi bor zla gdan la: thabs kyi cha 'dzin haṃ yig dkar po ni: mgo bo gyen bstan zla ltar gsal bar bsgom: mar sna lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la ni:

shes rab rnam pa a shad dmar gsal bsgom: snying gar yungs 'bru tsam gyi zla gdan steng: hūm̐ yig sngon po bkrag mdangs 'bar bar bsgom: mgrin par oṃ yig gyen bstan dmar po la: bde ba'i ro bcud ldan pa bskyed par bya: sa bon de dag bsgom gnas dhu ti'i nang: 'khor lo so so'i thad drag ro rkyang gnyis: dbu mar mdud pa dkris pa'i mtshams dbus su: dbu ma'i nang du rtsa 'khor dbus su bsgom: sbyangs pa'i tshad ni rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga: sa bon dang bcas dag gsal thon pa gnad: bag chags sgrib pa'i dbang gis skal zhan na: rtsa 'dab grangs dang dbyibs mdog 350)gsal dka' bas: gtso bo'i rtsa gsum dbus kyi sa bon rnams: gsal ngar thon par bya ba gnad du gces: de nas rlung lnga'i rnam dbye bsgom pa ni: spyi bor chu rlung mgrin par me yis rlung: snying gar nam mkha'i rlung dang lte ba ru: rlung gi rlung dang gsang gnas sa yi rlung: dkar dmar mthing gsal ljang ser kha dog 'bar: zla gam gru gsum zlum po gzhu yi dbyibs: gru bzhi la sogs go rim ma nor bar: dus dang khams dang bstun te brtson par bya: 'khor lo lnga yi ngo bo ye shes rtsa: rnam pa rtsa 'dab grangs su shar ba ni: sbyang gzhi ma dag sgo gsum dri ma rnams: sbyong byed rtsa rlung thig le gnad smin na: sbyangs 'bras rnam smin rig 'dzin nyer thob nas: rtsa dag rlung smin thig le sku ru rdzogs: myur lam gsang chen lam mchog thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: de nas rlung bcu'i rnam dbye bstan pa ni: rtsa ba'i rlung lnga gyen rgyu thur sel dang: me mnyam srog 'dzin khyab byed rnam pa lnga: gyen rgyu'i ngo bo rnam dag snang mtha' yas: rnam pa me rlung mgrin par gnas pa yis: zas kyi ro len brjod pa'i rten byed doḥ thur sel ngo bo dag pa 351)don yod grub: rnam pa rlung khams 'dzin pa gsang bar gnas: dri gshang 'dor zhing dwangs snyigs 'byed par byed:

me mnyam ngo bo dag pa rin chen 'byung: rnam pas rlung lte bar gnas pa la: zas zhu rlung gis dwangs snyigs 'dzin par byed: srog 'dzin rnam dag ngo bo mi bskyod pa: rnam pa chu khams rlung ste snying gar gnas: dran dang shes pa'i rten byed khyab byed ni: ngo bo rnam snang rnam pa nam mkha'i rlung: nang gi lhu tshigs la sogs kun la khyab: yan lag 'phen sdud 'gro ldang la sogs byed: lam dus srog 'dzin dang ni thur sel gnyis: ro rkyang lam nas gnyis gnyis mnyam du rgyu: me dang mnyam pa g.yas dang gyen rgyu g.yon: ro rkyang gnyis nas re re bzhin du rgyu: de dag las gyes phra ba'i rlung rnams kyi: rtsa ba chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ru gnas: pho rlung g.yas nas snga dro'i dus su rgyu: mo rlung g.yon nas phyi dro dgong mor rgyu: ma ning ye shes rlung ni skabs skabs su: sna bug gnyis nas mnyam du rgyu ba yin: pho la g.yas rlung mo la g.yon gyi rlung: cha mnyam rgyu ba ma ning rlung la bslabs: 352)de ltar rtsa ba'i rlung lnga gnad smin tshe: yan lag rlung lnga de yi grogs su 'byung: yan lag la yang rnam dbye 'di lta ste: rgyu ba rnam par rgyu dang yang dag rgyu: rab tu rgyu ba dang ni nges par rgyu: me khams nam mkha'i khams dang sa khams pa: chu khams dang ni rlung khams 'dzin pa yi: mthong thos snom byed myong dang lus dbang gnas: rang rang sgo nas 'byin 'jug g.yo bar byed: de ltar rlung bcu'i nyams len gnad dril nas: le lo med par phyi nang stong rar sbyangs: de yi nus pa rtsa rlung smin pa'i tshad: rlung zhugs gnas dang thim pa'i rtags rnams gsal: zhugs pa'i rtags ni 'byung lnga'i rlung bcud rnams: mi mngon tshul du ro rkyang lam nas rgyu: sna bug gnyis nas dbugs kyi rgyu ba ni: mi mngon mi tshor me rlung mnyam du rgyu: gnas pa lto ba mi 'gul 'greng nger gnas: thim pa khams lnga'i rlung dag rtags bcu dang:

thig le stong gzugs ma nges sna tshogs 'char: de dag lam rtags ma nor thon pa las: re rloms 'bras bur 'cha' ba'i gnas ma yin: brtags dpyad goms 'dris bla ma'i man ngag brten: sa ma ya: bzhi pa gtum mo'i 353)mtha' khrid man ngag ni: thig le bcud du smin pa'i thabs zab mo: rang nyid mkha' spyod rnal 'byor sngar bzhin gsal: sku dbus rtsa gsum 'khor lo bde chen du: rdo rje rigs kyi dpa' bo yab yum gyi: thugs klong khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs dang: longs spyod 'khor lo pad+ma dpa' bo yab yum: thugs klong dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma sogs: ma 'dres chu zla 'ja' tshon lta bur bsgom: sprul pa'i 'khor lor rat+na yab yum gyi: thugs klong gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: til gong 'phyur bzhin mngon 'dzin bral bar gsal: bde skyong 'khor lor karma dpa' bo yab yum: thugs klong 'jig 'das dam can tshogs rnams bsgom: yan lag sgo skyong ba spu'i bu ga kun: gnas yul dur khrod zhing skyong ḍā ki'i tshogs: gsal la ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por bsgom: dbu ma 'khor lo lnga yi srog shing ltar: gnas pa'i spyi bor zla gdan haṃ yig bsgom: mar sna lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la ni: a shad reg bya tsha 354)ba ngo bo bde: rnam pa me la byed las khams zhu ba: rtsa ba brtan pa rtse mo rno bar bsgom: ro rkyang gnyis ni dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon nas: 'khor lo lnga la 'khyu+ud pa'i tshul gyis ni: yar song klad pa'i steng nas tshur byung ste: smin mtshams nas brgyud sna bug gnyis la zug: mar sna lte 'og gnyer mo che thad nas: gong ma'i nang du tshud la khad pa ni: sbyangs pa lam gyi stobs kyis mthar tshud nges: de nas sngar ltar rlung dug bsal byas nas: ye shes rlung lnga sna bug gnyis nas drangs: ro rkyang lam brgyud lte ba'i rlung la phog: des bskul a shad rtse las ye shes me: mar mched gsang gnas rtsa 'khor thams cad khyab:

nyon mongs phrag dog rgyu dang bag chags rnams: lhag med btsan thabs nyid du bsregs par bsam: lte bar khyab pas nga rgyal rgyu bag chags: lhag med ye shes me yis bsregs par bsam: snying gar khyab pas gti mug sgrib pa bcom: rgyu dang bag chags sa bon lhag med bsregs: mgrin par khyab pas 'dod chags sgrib pa dang: rgyu dang bag chags ma lus bsregs par bsam: spyi bor khyab pas zhe 355)sdang bag chags rgyu: sgrib pa las nyon dang bcas lhag med du: bsregs par bsam zhing me dang haṃ yig gnyis: rig pa 'phrod pas haṃ las bdud rtsi'i 'od: bde stong ro ldan rgyal ba'i zhing kun khyab: bde gshegs dgyes bskang mchog thun yon tan kun: 'od dkar rnam par byung nas haṃ la thim: haṃ yig gzi brjid rab 'bar bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas bde chen 'khor lo'i rten brten pa: bde stong ros mnyes tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa sbyangs: bum pa'i dbang thob dga' ba'i ye shes skyes: me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon gyur bsam: me dang bdud rtsi bros dod tshul du ni: mgrin par khyab pas longs spyod 'khor lo yis: lha tshogs thams cad bde stong bdud rtsis mnyes: rang gzhan tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa kun dag nas: gsang dbang thob cing mchog dga' rgyud la skyes: so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon gyur bsam: bdud rtsi 'o rgyun lta bur snying gar khyab: lha tshogs dgyes tshims bde stong ye shes 'bar: bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs rtsa rlung sgrib pa sbyangs: sher dbang thob cing khyad dga' rgyud la skyes: chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i don rtogs bsam: bdud rtsi mar babs lte bar khyab cing spel: 356) sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rten dang brten par bcas: bde stong ros mnyes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas: tshig dbang thob cing lhan dga' rgyud la skyes: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon gyur bsam: bdud rtsi gsang bar babs nas khyab pa yis:

der brten lha tshogs bde stong mchod pas mnyes: tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyangs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang: thob cing dga' bral ye shes rgyud la skyes: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon gyur bsam: slar yang bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma yar ldog cing: mas nas yas rim dga' bzhis nyer drangs nas: stong bzhi'i 'od gsal dgongs pa mngon gyur bslab: dwangs ma gtsug tor haṃ dang gnyis med bsre: shes rab me nyid a shad la thim nas: ye shes 'od kyis bde drod rab 'bar bsam: de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i stong ra dang: mtha' khrid dang bcas yang yang bsgom pas na: phyi yi lus gzungs rgyas shing rtsa kha phye: nang gi dwangs ma 'phel zhing bde drod skye: gsang ba bde stong ye shes mngon gyur nas: rnam gsum 'khrul pa'i bag chags dbyings su bcom: thun mong thig le'i yon tan dpag med cing: thabs kyi phyag rgya la brten rig 'dzin gyi: sa ru tshe lus 357)'di ru 'khod par 'gyur: sa ma ya: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gi snying bcud 'di: las ldan rdo rje zhi ba mtsho nyid la: gces nor tshul du gdams pa 'di: snying mig srog las phongs na yang: phyi rabs las ldan rnams kyi don: zab mo brda yi ris su btab: ma 'ongs snyigs dus gdul dka'i tshe: shel dkar sprul pa dang 'phrad nas: chos 'di brda bsgyur byed par nges: dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog: log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: zab bo phyi rabs nyams su longs: sa ma ya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal nas rin chen gnyis pa dang reg bya nam mkha'i mdangs 'dzin bcas dus rig mo nas mtsho rgyal zhal lung skor 'beb thub bka' drin ma chung zhes yang yang nan cher bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du mdo med 'chol mo bde ba'i rdo rje'i yig ris su bgyis pa'o//
